SELECT MIN(MSEQ) as MSEQ, MSG_TYPE, MIN(DSTADDR) as DSTADDR, CALLBACK, STAT, SUBJECT, TEXT, INSERT_TIME, REQUEST_TIME, EXT_COL2, EXT_COL3, COUNT(*) as MESSAGE_COUNT, MAX(FILECNT) as FILECNT FROM msg_queue
GROUP BY MSG_TYPE, CALLBACK, SUBJECT, TEXT, INSERT_TIME, REQUEST_TIME, EXT_COL2, EXT_COL3, STAT ORDER BY REQUEST_TIME ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM msg_queue
GROUP BY MSG_TYPE, CALLBACK, SUBJECT, TEXT, INSERT_TIME, REQUEST_TIME, EXT_COL2, EXT_COL3, STAT ) t
